The '''Ebruchi homeworld''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Ebruchi]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] species, members of which were [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] that operated in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], were believed to have devastated the Ebruchi homeworld, whose remaining inhabitants fled the planet, only to ironically become [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] over [[Time/Legends|time]]. As the Ebruchi did not admit failure, they erased their homeworld's devastation from their common memory.<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ebruchi homeworld was introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
